Description: Verify GET /web/quote initial page load renders the page and the buy button is NOT visible on screen (visibility assertion, not attribute check) — proves B5/X1.
Steps: Call GET /web/quote with no auth header and no cookie; render the returned HTML in a browser; assert the buy-button element is NOT visible (Playwright expect(locator).toBeHidden() / not.toBeVisible())
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. HTML contains ['ONODE Parking', 'รถยนต์', 'มอเตอร์ไซค์', 'จำนวนเดือน', 'ดูราคา', 'data-testid="buy-button"']. Buy button visibility assertion: NOT visible (toBeHidden passes).

Description: Verify clicking ดูราคา with no vehicle selected shows 'vehicle is required' in error-message and the buy button is NOT visible — proves B6/X2.
Steps: Call GET /web/quote; render in browser; leave vehicle unselected; click 'quote-button'; assert error-message shows 'vehicle is required' and buy-button is NOT visible (toBeHidden)
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. HTML contains ['ONODE Parking', 'vehicle is required']. Buy button visibility assertion: NOT visible (toBeHidden passes).

Description: Verify when the quote call fails with a server error (intercepted 500) the page shows 'ไม่สามารถคำนวณราคาได้ในขณะนี้ กรุณาลองใหม่' and the buy button is NOT visible — proves B7/X3.
Steps: Call GET /web/quote; render in browser; intercept POST /passes/quote to return HTTP 500; select 'vehicle-car', enter '3' in 'months-input', click 'quote-button'; assert error-message shows 'ไม่สามารถคำนวณราคาได้ในขณะนี้ กรุณาลองใหม่' and buy-button is NOT visible (toBeHidden)
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. HTML contains ['ONODE Parking', 'ไม่สามารถคำนวณราคาได้ในขณะนี้ กรุณาลองใหม่']. Buy button visibility assertion: NOT visible (toBeHidden passes).

Description: Verify a successful quote (car, 3 months) renders '4500 THB', 'discount 0%', 'ราคาต่อเดือน 1500 THB' and the buy button becomes VISIBLE with href /web/buy?vehicle=car&months=3 — proves B8/X4.
Steps: Call GET /web/quote; render in browser; select 'vehicle-car', enter '3' in 'months-input', click 'quote-button'; assert quote-price shows '4500 THB', quote-discount shows 'discount 0%', quote-monthly-rate shows 'ราคาต่อเดือน 1500 THB', and buy-button is VISIBLE with href '/web/buy?vehicle=car&months=3'
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. HTML contains ['4500 THB', 'discount 0%', 'ราคาต่อเดือน 1500 THB', 'ซื้อเลย']. Buy button visibility assertion: VISIBLE (toBeVisible passes) with href '/web/buy?vehicle=car&months=3'.

Description: Verify after a successful quote, a subsequent failed quote (months 13 -> 400 'months must be an integer from 1 to 12') clears the previous result and the buy button is NOT visible again (no stale visibility) — proves B9/X5.
Steps: Call GET /web/quote; render in browser; select 'vehicle-car', enter '3' in 'months-input', click 'quote-button'; assert buy-button is VISIBLE | Enter '13' in 'months-input', click 'quote-button'; assert error-message shows 'months must be an integer from 1 to 12' and buy-button is NOT visible (toBeHidden)
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. HTML contains ['4500 THB', 'discount 0%', 'ราคาต่อเดือน 1500 THB', 'ซื้อเลย']. Buy button visibility assertion: VISIBLE (toBeVisible passes). | HTTP 200 OK. HTML contains ['months must be an integer from 1 to 12']. Buy button visibility assertion: NOT visible (toBeHidden passes) — no stale visibility from the earlier success.

Description: Verify GET /web/quote stays public (no login, no cookie, no auth header) and always answers 200 with Content-Type text/html; it never redirects and never returns JSON — proves B1.
Steps: Call GET /web/quote with no auth header, no cookie, and follow_redirects=False
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. Response Content-Type contains 'text/html'. HTML contains ['ONODE Parking', 'data-testid="quote-screen"']. No redirect (status is 200, not 3xx). Body is not JSON.

Description: Verify the buy button element keeps the hidden attribute in the initial markup AND the page CSS makes a hidden buy button compute to display:none (the .buy rule must not override the browser's [hidden] default) — proves B4.
Steps: Call GET /web/quote; assert the buy-button element carries the hidden attribute in the initial markup; assert the page CSS contains a rule that makes a hidden .buy element compute to display:none (e.g. '.buy[hidden]' with 'display:none')
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. HTML contains ['data-testid="buy-button"', 'hidden', '.buy[hidden]', 'display:none']. The buy button carries the hidden attribute in the initial markup and the CSS rule makes a hidden .buy compute to display:none.

Description: Verify 'not visible' is proven with a real visibility assertion (Playwright toBeHidden / not.toBeVisible), never by checking the hidden attribute — the attribute is present in the buggy version too. Proves X7.
Steps: Call GET /web/quote; render in browser; assert the buy-button element is NOT visible using a visibility assertion (Playwright expect(locator).toBeHidden() / not.toBeVisible()); do NOT assert on the hidden attribute alone
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. HTML contains ['data-testid="buy-button"']. Buy button visibility assertion: NOT visible (toBeHidden passes) — proven by computed visibility, not by the hidden attribute.

Description: Verify this card changes no API, no request body, no error string and no other layout of the page: the page still calls POST /passes/quote with the same body and renders the same ONODE-24 error strings — proves B10.
Steps: Call GET /web/quote; render in browser; select 'vehicle-car', enter '3' in 'months-input', click 'quote-button'; capture the outgoing request to POST /passes/quote and assert its body is unchanged from ONODE-24; then enter '13' and click 'quote-button' and assert the rendered error string is the ONODE-24 string 'months must be an integer from 1 to 12'
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. HTML contains ['4500 THB', 'discount 0%', 'ราคาต่อเดือน 1500 THB', 'ซื้อเลย', 'months must be an integer from 1 to 12']. The outgoing POST /passes/quote request body is unchanged from ONODE-24 and every rendered error string is the ONODE-24 string verbatim.
